description: Create a new Server Alias (domain alias) for the existing virtual server 'acmecorp.test'. The alias domain name should be 'acme-corp.test'. Ensure the alias has the 'Setup website for domain', 'Setup DNS zone', and 'Accept mail for domain' features enabled. You can do this by selecting the 'acmecorp.test' server, clicking 'Create Virtual Server', and selecting 'Alias of acmecorp.test' as the server mode.
